A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work, Learning to Help in Multi-Class Settings. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–G support reliable comparison. All appendix pages render identically.

before.justification: Section 5 and Appendix G report original CIFAR-10, SVHN, and CIFAR-100 experiments, including accuracy, rejection rates, convergence, missing-class tests, and baseline comparisons.

after.justification: v2 retains the original empirical results in Section 5 and Appendix G, including classification, synchronization, and bounded-rejection experiments.

M1.justification: The fixed-client framework, stage-switching surrogate loss, synchronous and asynchronous training, and stochastic post-hoc inference remain unchanged in Sections 2–4 and Appendix F.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate CIFAR-10, SVHN, and CIFAR-100 under the same pay-per-request, intermittent-availability, and bounded-reject-rate scenarios. Appendix G retains the same missing-class scenarios.

E2.justification: The evaluated comparators are unchanged, including client-only and server-only predictions in Tables 5–6 and random rejection in Figure 7. No comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: The reported architectures, dataset splits, cost settings, synchronization intervals, evaluation metrics, and bounded-rejection calibration and testing procedures are unchanged in Sections 4–5 and Appendices F–G.

E4.justification: Cost sensitivity, synchronization and convergence comparisons, missing-class robustness tests, and qualitative inspection of locally retained versus rejected SVHN images are retained without revision.

E5.justification: The experimental text, tables, and plots retain the same statistical reporting. v2 introduces no run-count or seed information, uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All result entries in Tables 1 and 3–7 and findings displayed in Figures 2–7 are unchanged. For example, the missing-class experiments retain overall joint accuracies of 72.0% on CIFAR-10 and 89.0% on SVHN in Tables 5–6.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, Bayes-optimality theorem, convexity/monotonicity proposition, and consistency theorem are unchanged. Their proofs in Appendices C–E are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims: extending L2H to multiclass classification, providing a consistent stage-switching surrogate, and supporting three server-access scenarios.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning accuracy versus server usage, synchronization delays, difficult-image rejection, and missing-class robustness are unchanged. No substantive limitation or applicability qualification is added.

D1.justification: v2 adds a clickable GitHub repository icon after the abstract, linking to L2H_multi; this access pointer is absent from v1. Appendix G's implementation, hardware, and training-time disclosures remain unchanged. Repository contents are not established by the supplied PDFs.

R1.justification: The cited works and positioning relative to learning with abstention, learning to defer, and prior binary L2H are unchanged, including the comparisons in Appendices A–B.

P1.justification: v2 adds an NSF/RINGS funding acknowledgment, lightly revises the opening wording of Section 2, and corrects 'nad' to 'and' in Figure 2's caption. Section and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The repository icon and added funding footnote modify the first-page layout, with modest text reflow across pages 1–6. Figure 2's caption is corrected; scientific figures, table structures, axes, legends, and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The added repository pointer makes the implementation easier to locate, while the funding acknowledgment and small wording corrections modestly improve documentation. The methods, proofs, and empirical evidence remain unchanged. This limited benefit does not depend on assuming anything about the uninspected repository contents.
